October 14, 30.

Sir,

With reference to your letter of
October 8, 1930, I have to inform you that
there is nothing in Municipal Police records
against Mr. Victor M. Krivoroochko, who has
applied to your Consulate for a visa to proceed
to Hongkong.

I am, Sir,
Your Obedient Servant,

Deputy Commissioner
(Crime & Special Branches)

P.A. North Esq.,
H.B.M. Consulate-General,
Shanghai.

先生：

关于您1930年10月8日的来信，兹告知您，在工部局警务处档案中，没有任何针对维克多·M·克里沃鲁奇科（Victor M. Krivoroochko）先生的不利记录，该先生已向贵领事馆申请前往香港的签证。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Special Branch No. 2. Station,
REPORT
Date October 13, 1930.
Subject (in full) Victor M. Krivoroochko.
Made by D.S. Faddeeff. Forwarded by Whamean WSD
Sir,
With reference to the attached letter of October
8, 1930 from H.B.M. Consulate General re: Mr. Victor M.
Krivoroochko, inquiries show that Mr. V.M. Krivoroochko
is Russian, 39 years of age, married, residing at No. 220
Route Tenant de-la-tour. He arrived in Shanghai from
Vladivostok in November 1922. Formerly Mr. Krivoroochko
was a White Russian officer and until 1922 he had been
in various White anti-Bolshevik groups. Since his arrival
here in 1922 he has been employed by Messrs Dodge & Seymour
(China) Ltd., No. 3 Canton Road and his intention is to
travel to Hongkong in connection with the business affairs
of the above firm. He is not known to be connected with
political work, and there is nothing in Municipal Police
records to his detriment.
D. S. Faddeeff
D. S.
D. C. (C. & S. Branches)
Reg. Please prepare letter
in above sense in reply
to Mr North.

报告
日期 1930年10月13日。
事由（全称）维克多·M·克里沃鲁奇科。
呈报人 D.S. Faddeeff。转呈人 Whamean WSD
先生：

关于附上的英国总领事馆1930年10月8日有关维克多·M·克里沃鲁奇科先生的信件，经查询，维克多·M·克里沃鲁奇科先生系俄国人，39岁，已婚，居住于陶尔斐司路（Route Tenant de-la-tour）220号。他于1922年11月从符拉迪沃斯托克（Vladivostok）抵达上海。克里沃鲁奇科先生以前是一名白俄军官，直到1922年一直隶属于各个白俄反布尔什维克团体。自1922年抵沪以来，他受雇于广东路3号的道奇与西摩（中国）有限公司（Messrs Dodge & Seymour (China) Ltd.），其意图是代表上述公司因商务事宜前往香港。据知他与政治活动无关，且工部局警务处档案中没有任何对他不利的记录。

D. S. Faddeeff
D. S.
副总监（刑事与特别部门）
批注：请按上述意思拟复信给 North 先生。
30年10月14日

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE S. B. REC. S. D. 1640. Date 9 - 10 - 30.）
th October, 1930.

Sir,

I beg to inform you that application
has been made to this office by Mr.
Victor K. Krivoroochko, a non-Soviet
Russian citizen, for a visa to enable him
to travel to Hongkong.

Mr. Krivoroochko is employed by
Messrs. Dodge & Seymour (China) Ltd., 8,
Canton Road, and I should be obliged if you
could inform me whether anything is known
against him.

I am,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,

（签名：F. W. North）

The Commissioner,
Shanghai Municipal Police,
SHANGHAI.

1930年10月 日。

先生：

谨此告知，非苏维埃俄国公民维克多·K·克里沃鲁奇科先生已向本办公室提出申请，请求签发以便其前往香港的签证。

克里沃鲁奇科先生受雇于广东路8号的道奇与西摩（中国）有限公司（Messrs. Dodge & Seymour (China) Ltd.），如蒙告知是否掌握任何针对他的不利情况，我将不胜感激。

此致，
先生，
您的恭顺仆人，

（签名：F. W. North）

上海公共租界工部局警务处总监，
上海。
